title: Ronin Athletics — Policies (Internal)
text: # Ronin Athletics — Policies (Internal)

title: MAP (Minimum Advertised Price) Policy
text:
## MAP (Minimum Advertised Price) Policy
- MAP is enforced on all marketplaces including Amazon. Advertising below MAP is a violation.
- Current MAP: Shogun Gi $129, Tengu Rashguard $49, Kage Shorts $44, Yurei Spats $39, Ranked Belt $19, Core Hoodie $54.
- Promotional exception: coupons up to 15% off MAP are permitted during official sale windows (Black Friday, Prime Day, brand anniversary in July). Anything deeper requires VP Sales sign-off.
- MAP violations by a reseller trigger a 2-strike process: written warning, then supply suspension.

title: Return & Refund Policy (DTC + Amazon)
text:
## Return & Refund Policy (DTC + Amazon)
- 30-day returns on unworn items with tags. Gis must be unwashed.
- Amazon FBA returns follow Amazon's standard policy; we do not extend beyond 30 days.
- Defective items (stitching, print peel) are replaced free within 90 days — this is a warranty claim, not a return.
- Refunds are processed to the original payment method within 5 business days of receiving the item.

title: Warranty
text:
## Warranty
- 90-day workmanship warranty on all gis and rashguards (seams, stitching, sublimation).
- Belts and accessories carry a 30-day warranty.
- Warranty does not cover normal wear, improper washing (hot water / bleach), or competition damage.

title: Shipping SLA
text:
## Shipping SLA
- DTC orders ship within 1 business day; 2-5 day delivery in the continental US.
- Amazon FBA handles Prime SLA for FBA ASINs.
- Free DTC shipping over $99.

title: Amazon Account Health Guardrails
text:
## Amazon Account Health Guardrails
- Never advertise below MAP on Amazon (protects Buy Box and brand).
- Order Defect Rate (ODR) target < 1%. Late Shipment Rate target < 4%.
- Any listing suppression or policy warning is a P1 incident — escalate to the Amazon channel owner immediately.

title: Ronin Athletics — Standard Operating Procedures (Internal)
text: # Ronin Athletics — Standard Operating Procedures (Internal)

title: SOP-01: Responding to a BSR Drop
text:
## SOP-01: Responding to a BSR Drop
When a flagship ASIN's Best Seller Rank worsens (higher number) by more than 3 positions week-over-week:
1. Check whether a competitor changed price or launched a Sponsored placement (see competitor tracker).
2. Verify our Buy Box is intact and price is at MAP (never below).
3. Check inventory — a BSR drop plus low inventory usually means we are being suppressed on availability.
4. If competitor undercut on price and our margin allows, request a coupon (up to 15% off MAP) rather than a MAP change.
5. Post a summary to the #amazon-ops channel and tag the channel owner.

title: SOP-02: Listing Optimization Checklist
text:
## SOP-02: Listing Optimization Checklist
- Title: brand + product line + key attribute + size/color, under 200 chars.
- Bullets: lead with IBJJF-legal, GSM weight, seam construction, care.
- A+ content refreshed each quarter.
- Backend search terms include competitor brand-adjacent generic terms (never trademarked brand names).

title: SOP-03: Review Response Protocol
text:
## SOP-03: Review Response Protocol
- Respond to all 1-3 star reviews within 24 hours.
- Defective-product reviews trigger a warranty replacement offer.
- Never dispute a sizing complaint — point to the size chart and offer an exchange.

title: SOP-04: Restock Rules
text:
## SOP-04: Restock Rules
- Reorder trigger: 6 weeks of forward cover based on trailing 4-week velocity.
- Flagship Shogun Gi never goes below 800 units on hand (stockout risk to #1 BSR).
- Belts are high-attach accessories; keep 4+ weeks cover to protect gi conversion.

title: SOP-05: Daily Amazon Brief (what the report agent compiles)
text:
## SOP-05: Daily Amazon Brief (what the report agent compiles)
Every morning the brief should include: flagship BSR and week-over-week delta, any competitor price/BSR moves, inventory risks (any SKU under reorder trigger), and one recommended action.

title: Ronin Athletics — Brand Brief (Internal)
text: # Ronin Athletics — Brand Brief (Internal)

title: Positioning
text:
## Positioning
Ronin Athletics is the #1 Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu apparel brand on Amazon US. We make competition-grade, IBJJF-legal gear that a serious hobbyist or competitor can afford. "Masterless warrior, disciplined craft."

title: Target Customer
text:
## Target Customer
- Core: 24-40 year old BJJ practitioners training 3+ times per week, blue-to-brown belt.
- Secondary: MMA and grappling crossover athletes; gift buyers for practitioners.

title: Voice
text:
## Voice
- Confident, technical, respectful of the art. No hype, no fake scarcity.
- We talk like a training partner who knows their gear, not a salesperson.

title: Channels
text:
## Channels
- Amazon US (primary, ~70% of revenue), Shopify DTC (~25%), wholesale to gyms (~5%).
- Omnichannel: Amazon drives discovery; DTC captures repeat and higher-margin lifestyle line.

title: Margin Philosophy
text:
## Margin Philosophy
- Protect the #1 BSR on the flagship Shogun Gi at all costs — it is the top of the funnel.
- Defend price with coupons and value, not MAP erosion.
- Grow blended margin via accessories (belts, spats) and the higher-margin Core lifestyle line.
